== Strategy ==

Strategy:

You'll want to start with the Death Star to start with a lot of Force.  The starting interrupt will get incon losses and combat response out.  Your objective is to get to the Death Star with the Executor before your opponent can get there to force drain.  You will need it and a Death Squadron Star Destroyer to take the death star for the most part.  once that's done deploy kashyyyk and then use lateral damage to cripple any starship at death star or kashyyyk since they won't be able to get to the utinni effect unless a planet in between is deployed.  next get ready for a ground assault with your tempests and remaining characters. force generation is crucial in this deck so that you can get the executor and any ground forces out.  use elis helrot if another unrelated site is deployed so that you can move your guys there.  give me some feedback on how this deck looks
